nursery.keptLine: The second upgrade makes the kitchen and the bedroom larger. One added room is empty. The other has a crib and two child beds, and you can have two children ([Farmhouse](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Farmhouse), [Carpenter's Shop](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Carpenter%27s_Shop)).
